To heighten your senses, we created a few of our own. Sophisticated safety innovations
that alert you to hazards and help you avoid collisions—or lessen their impact. That’s the
thinking behind i-Activsense.® This standard suite of select i-Activsense® safety features1
such as Blind Spot Monitoring2 and Rear Cross Traffic Alert2 help improve your visibility
and awareness of the road.
1 i-Activsense® safety features are not a substitute for safe and attentive driving. There are limitations to the range and detection of each safety feature. Additional information provided in Specifications. Please see your Owner’s Manual for further details. 2 Always check your
mirrors. Be aware of the traffic around you. There are limitations to the range and detection of the system. Please see your Owner’s Manual for further details.

ENGINES
SKYACTIV®-G 2.5L DOHC 16-valve 4-cylinder engine with Cylinder Deactivation (Sport, Touring)
187 hp @ 6,000 rpm
186 lb-ft of torque @ 4,000 rpm
SKYACTIV-G 2.5T DOHC 16-valve 4-cylinder Dynamic Pressure Turbo engine (Grand Touring, Grand Touring Reserve and Signature)
SPECIFICATIONS 250 hp @ 5,000 rpm (with 93 octane fuel)
227 hp @ 5,000 rpm (with 87 octane fuel)
310 lb-ft of torque @ 2,000 rpm
TRANSMISSION & DRIVETRAIN
SKYACTIV-Drive 6-speed automatic with manual shift and Sport modes
SKYACTIV-VEHICLE DYNAMICS with G-Vectoring Control Plus
Hill Launch Assist1
FUEL ECONOMY EPA-estimated MPG (city/highway)2
26/35 (Sport and Touring)
23/31 (Grand Touring, Grand Touring Reserve and Signature)
FUEL TANK CAPACITY
16.4 U.S. gallons
DIMENSIONS
Overall length: 192.7"
Wheelbase: 111.4"
Width: 72.4"
Height: 57.1"
TRUNK CAPACITY
14.7 cubic feet
1 Hill Launch Assist is an auxiliary device that assists the driver in accelerating from a stop while on a slope. It is not a substitute for safe and attentive driving. There are limitations to the system. Please see your Owner’s Manual for further details. 2 EPA-estimated mileage. Actual results will vary.

Always check your surroundings. 11 Requires compatible phone and standard text and data rates apply. Third-party interface providers are solely responsible for their product

Start, Side Window Deflectors, Alloy Pedals, Collapsible Cargo Carrier driver steering input can all affect whether DSC will be effective in preventing loss of control.
